Dahu 0.94.2 beta for Windows

Changes since 0.92.2:
- New compact Preferences window: Appearance, Viewport and Navigation, with labels above grouped fields and a stable layout.
- Selection colour palette and direct custom colour picker; independent edge/curve widths; navigation sensitivity and zoom direction.
- Windows SpaceMouse navigation with sensitivity, axis inversion, optional roll and assignable Fit/Orbit buttons.
- Adaptive high-resolution navigation restores full display detail at rest; display diagnostics available under Command reference > Support information.
- Accepted updates keep a blocking progress window open with an animated wait indicator and clear automatic close/restart feedback.

Validation: 145 automated checks, plus isolated Windows desktop and updater checks. Physical SpaceMouse Pro Wireless and Dell XPS 15 9520 4K acceptance remain pending.

Includes installer, updater signature and corresponding AGPL source archive. The Windows installer is not Authenticode-signed.
